A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
Careful by design.

I’m Yucheng Feng, also known as Tobie. My work spans financial tools, creator platforms and everyday interactions. I start with people’s behaviour, untangle the requirements, and give complex systems a form people can understand.

FocusUser research, interaction design, component systems, physical and digital experiences
EducationUniversity of Southampton · MA Communication Design
